sections.overview: Panchatikta Ghrita Guggulu – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage
sections.introduction: Panchatikta Ghrita Guggulu is classical Ayurvedic formulation that keeps the tridoshas Vata, Pitta and Kapha calm. It is blood purifier and good for skin diseases.
sections.ingredients_and_method_of_preparation:
Nimba (Neem) – 480 g 
 Patola ( Trichosanthes dioica ) – 480 g 
 Vyaghri ( Solanum xanthocarpum ) – 480 g 
 Guduchi ( Tinospora cordifolia ) – 480 g 
 Vasa ( Adhatoda vasica ) – 480 g 
 Water for decoction – 12.288 liters boiled and reduced to 3.072 liters 
 Ghrita (Ghee) – 768 ml 

 12 grams of each of:- 

 Patha ( Cyclea peltata / Cissampelos pariera ) 
 Vidanga ( Embelia ribes ) 
 Suradaru ( Cedrus deodara ) 
 Gajopakulya ( Piper chaba ) 
 Yavakshara ( Hordeum vulgare ) 
 Sarjikshara 
 Nagara ( Zingiber officinalis ) 
 Nisha (Turmeric) 
 Mishreya ( Anethum sowa ) 
 Chavya (Piper chaba ) 
 Kushta ( Saussurea lappa ) 
 Tejovati ( Zanthoxylum alatum ) 
 Maricha (Black pepper) 
 Vatsaka ( Holarrhena antidysenterica ) 
 Deepyaka ( Trachyspermum ammi ) 
 Agni ( Plumbago zeylanica ) 
 Rohini ( Picrorrhiza kurroa ) 
 Arushkara ( Semecarpus anacardium ) – Purified 
 Vacha ( Acorus calamus ) 
 Kanamoola ( Piper longum ) – root 
 Yukta ( Pluchea lanceolata ) 
 Manjishta ( Rubia cordifolia ) 
 Ativisha ( Aconitum heterophyllum ) 
 Vishani (Aconitum species) 
 Yavani ( Trachyspermum ammi ) 
 Shuddha Guggulu ( Commiphora mukul ) – Purified – 240 g 

 Use all the above given ingredients in the prescribed amount and heat them till herbal ghee is obtained. 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Panchatikta Ghrita Guggulu possesses so many medicinal properties – Antioxidant, Antipruritic, Demulcent, Depurative (purifies blood), Neuro-protective, Anti-rheumatic, Anti-arthritic, Anti-inflammatory and Analgesic etc. This Ayurvedic medicine has potent use in managing the skin problems like in psoriasis, eczema it reduces the inflammation and provides cooling effects. It is good for non-healing wounds. 
 It is also helpful in digestive problems, improves the digestion and combats bloating and gastritis. Panchatikta Ghrita Guggulu has ability to manage the symptoms of piles, relieving the painful condition as well as has healing effect in fissure formation too. Reduces the trouble of abdominal distention. 
 It is a very good blood purifier that helps to eliminate toxins from the body. 
 This guggulu is suitable herbal remedy even for deep seated ulcers and helps to get relief from discomfort of abscess. Also good to improve the taste in case of tastelessness. 
 It is also effective in respiratory problems like asthma, cough, sinusitis and shortness of breath. Also possesses properties to deal with cardiac problems and relieves the patient from the pain and inflammatory condition of gout.
sections.therapeutic_uses:
To treat deep seated ulcers, abscess and sinus. 
 Also effective in asthma, rhinitis, cough, cold, cardiac diseases and gout. 
 It can bring about cooling effect and useful in the inflamed part of the body. 
 Traditionally it was used in conditions like psoriasis and arthritis. 
 It can even be given to improve digestion. 
 Helpful to eliminate toxins by purifying the blood. 
 Its benefit in skin disorders of vata and kapha prevalence.
sections.dose: 6-10 gm with 100 ml of milk. It can be consumed along with warm water.
sections.contraindications_side_effects:
Till now no known side effects with this medicine has been reported. 
 It is advised to avoid its self-medication and consume it under strict medical directions. 
 People with conditions like diabetes, high cholesterol, heart diseases and high BP must be very cautious. 
 Its high dose, might leads to diarrhea and indigestion. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

Panchatikta Ghrita Guggulu – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference: Ashtanga Hridayam chikitsa sthana 21/57-60 
 Introduction 
 Panchatikta Ghrita Guggulu is classical Ayurvedic formulation that keeps the tridoshas Vata, Pitta and Kapha calm. It is blood purifier and good for skin diseases. 
 Ingredients and Method of Preparation 
 
 Nimba (Neem) – 480 g 
 Patola ( Trichosanthes dioica ) – 480 g 
 Vyaghri ( Solanum xanthocarpum ) – 480 g 
 Guduchi ( Tinospora cordifolia ) – 480 g 
 Vasa ( Adhatoda vasica ) – 480 g 
 Water for decoction – 12.288 liters boiled and reduced to 3.072 liters 
 Ghrita (Ghee) – 768 ml 
 
 12 grams of each of:- 
 
 Patha ( Cyclea peltata / Cissampelos pariera ) 
 Vidanga ( Embelia ribes ) 
 Suradaru ( Cedrus deodara ) 
 Gajopakulya ( Piper chaba ) 
 Yavakshara ( Hordeum vulgare ) 
 Sarjikshara 
 Nagara ( Zingiber officinalis ) 
 Nisha (Turmeric) 
 Mishreya ( Anethum sowa ) 
 Chavya (Piper chaba ) 
 Kushta ( Saussurea lappa ) 
 Tejovati ( Zanthoxylum alatum ) 
 Maricha (Black pepper) 
 Vatsaka ( Holarrhena antidysenterica ) 
 Deepyaka ( Trachyspermum ammi ) 
 Agni ( Plumbago zeylanica ) 
 Rohini ( Picrorrhiza kurroa ) 
 Arushkara ( Semecarpus anacardium ) – Purified 
 Vacha ( Acorus calamus ) 
 Kanamoola ( Piper longum ) – root 
 Yukta ( Pluchea lanceolata ) 
 Manjishta ( Rubia cordifolia ) 
 Ativisha ( Aconitum heterophyllum ) 
 Vishani (Aconitum species) 
 Yavani ( Trachyspermum ammi ) 
 Shuddha Guggulu ( Commiphora mukul ) – Purified – 240 g 
 
 Use all the above given ingredients in the prescribed amount and heat them till herbal ghee is obtained. 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Panchatikta Ghrita Guggulu possesses so many medicinal properties – Antioxidant, Antipruritic, Demulcent, Depurative (purifies blood), Neuro-protective, Anti-rheumatic, Anti-arthritic, Anti-inflammatory and Analgesic etc. This Ayurvedic medicine has potent use in managing the skin problems like in psoriasis, eczema it reduces the inflammation and provides cooling effects. It is good for non-healing wounds. 
 It is also helpful in digestive problems, improves the digestion and combats bloating and gastritis. Panchatikta Ghrita Guggulu has ability to manage the symptoms of piles, relieving the painful condition as well as has healing effect in fissure formation too. Reduces the trouble of abdominal distention. 
 It is a very good blood purifier that helps to eliminate toxins from the body. 
 This guggulu is suitable herbal remedy even for deep seated ulcers and helps to get relief from discomfort of abscess. Also good to improve the taste in case of tastelessness. 
 It is also effective in respiratory problems like asthma, cough, sinusitis and shortness of breath. Also possesses properties to deal with cardiac problems and relieves the patient from the pain and inflammatory condition of gout. 
 Therapeutic Uses 
 
 To treat deep seated ulcers, abscess and sinus. 
 Also effective in asthma, rhinitis, cough, cold, cardiac diseases and gout. 
 It can bring about cooling effect and useful in the inflamed part of the body. 
 Traditionally it was used in conditions like psoriasis and arthritis. 
 It can even be given to improve digestion. 
 Helpful to eliminate toxins by purifying the blood. 
 Its benefit in skin disorders of vata and kapha prevalence. 
 
 Dose 
 6-10 gm with 100 ml of milk. It can be consumed along with warm water. 
 Contraindications/ Side Effects 
 
 Till now no known side effects with this medicine has been reported. 
 It is advised to avoid its self-medication and consume it under strict medical directions. 
 People with conditions like diabetes, high cholesterol, heart diseases and high BP must be very cautious. 
 Its high dose, might leads to diarrhea and indigestion. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
